ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail behavior when a contract is deployed to a precompile address range (0x01-0x12) - whether this is prevented or if precompile takes precedence.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume precompiles always take precedence over any contract code at these addresses. Contract deployment to precompile addresses should be treated as calling the precompile.

ambiguities.text: The boundary between precompile addresses (ending at 0x11/0x12) and regular contract addresses is not explicitly stated.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume addresses 0x01 through 0x11 (17 addresses in Prague) are reserved for precompiles. Address 0x00 is special (empty), and 0x12+ are normal addresses.

implicit_assumptions.description: The precompile implementations in PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS are trusted native code that executes with full access to EVM internals.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compromised or buggy precompile implementations could corrupt EVM state or leak sensitive information.

implicit_assumptions.description: The PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS mapping is immutable at runtime and cannot be modified by contracts or transactions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Ability to modify the mapping could allow redirecting precompile calls to malicious implementations.

implicit_assumptions.description: Dictionary lookup for precompile dispatch is O(1) constant time regardless of which precompile is being called.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Variable lookup time could enable timing attacks to fingerprint which precompiles a contract uses.
